Name: Pokemon Eggventure - Digspot
Author: Parme69
Description:
[center]Replace the classic artifact spots in [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] with Pokémon-themed alternatives!


Instead of the usual worms sticking out of the ground, artifact spots can now appear as [b]Poké Balls[/b], [b]Diglett[/b], [b]Alolan Diglett[/b], or [b]Wiglett[/b], bringing a fun Pokémon-inspired twist to your exploration.

The mod is fully configurable, allowing you to choose exactly which appearance you want (41 appearances) —or let the game pick one at random.


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/0ryTJqxk/features.png[/img]
[/center]
[center]Replaces Stardew Valley 1.6 artifact spots with Pokémon-themed alternatives.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][u][b]Choose between: [/b][/u][/center]
[center]Poké Ball / Diglett / Alolan Diglett / Wiglett
[/center]
[center]Optional [b]Random[/b] mode to randomly select one of the available appearances[/center]
[center]Fully configurable[/center]
[center]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6[/center]
[center]No gameplay changes

[/center]
[center]This mod is part of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49098][b]Pokémon Eggventure[/b] project[/url], but it can also be used as a standalone visual enhancement.[/center]
